Contract AirportSystem::createStaff(id:Integer,name:String,pswd:String,phone:String,role:Integer,bossid:Integer): Boolean {
          definition:
          boss:Staff = Staff.allInstances()->any(s:Staff | s.Id = bossid)
            
            precondition:
          Staff.allInstances()->select(s:Staff | s.Id = id)->isEmpty()
            
            postcondition:
          let newStaff:Staff in newStaff.oclIsNew() and Staff.allInstances()->includes(newStaff) and newStaff.Id = id and newStaff.Name = name and newStaff.Password = pswd and newStaff.Phone = phone and newStaff.Role = role and (if boss.oclIsUndefined() = false then newStaff.Boss = boss else newStaff.Boss = null endif) and result = true
            
        }

Contract ProcessSaleService::endSale(): Real {
          definition:
          lineTotal:Real = self.CurrentSale.ContainedSalesLine.Subamount->sum()
            
            precondition:
          self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = false
            
            postcondition:
          self.CurrentSale.Amount = lineTotal and self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and result = lineTotal
            
        }

Contract ProcessSaleService::endSale(): Real {
          definition:
          lineItems:Set(SalesLineItem) = self.CurrentSale.ContainedSalesLine, lineTotal:Real = lineItems->collect(item:SalesLineItem | item.Subamount)->sum()
            
            precondition:
          self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = false
            
            postcondition:
          self.CurrentSale.Amount = lineTotal and self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and result = lineTotal
            
        }

errors.msg: [generation-semantics] oclIsNew() is permitted only in a postcondition.

contract:
Contract ProcessSaleService::makeCashPayment(amount:Real): Boolean {
          definition:
          currentStore:Store = Store.allInstances()->any(s:Store | s.IsOpened = true), newCashPayment:CashPayment = CashPayment.allInstances()->any(cp:CashPayment | cp.oclIsNew())
            
            precondition:
          self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and amount >= self.CurrentSale.Amount
            
            postcondition:
          newCashPayment.oclIsNew() and newCashPayment.AmountTendered = amount and newCashPayment.Balance = amount - self.CurrentSale.Amount and newCashPayment.BelongedSale = self.CurrentSale and self.CurrentSale.AssoicatedPayment = newCashPayment and self.CurrentSale.Belongedstore = currentStore and self.CurrentSale.Time = Now and self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = true and CashPayment.allInstances()->includes(newCashPayment) and result = true
            
        }

Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
          definition:
          suspendedUsers:Set(User) = User.allInstances()->select(u:User | u.SuspensionDays > 0)
            
            precondition:
          true
            
            postcondition:
          suspendedUsers->forAll(u:User | u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays@pre - 1 and if u.SuspensionDays@pre - 1 = 0 and u.OverDueFee = 0 then u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::NORMAL else true endif)
            
        }

Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::recommendBook(uid:String,callNo:String,title:String,edition:String,author:String,publisher:String,description:String,isbn:String): Boolean {
          definition:
          user:User = User.allInstances()->any(u:User | u.UserID = uid)
            
            precondition:
          user.oclIsUndefined() = false and Book.allInstances()->select(b:Book | b.CallNo = callNo)->isEmpty()
            
            postcondition:
          let newRec:RecommendBook in newRec.oclIsNew() and RecommendBook.allInstances()->includes(newRec) and newRec.CallNo = callNo and newRec.Title = title and newRec.Edition = edition and newRec.Author = author and newRec.Publisher = publisher and newRec.Description = description and newRec.ISBn = isbn and newRec.RecommendDate = Today and newRec.RecommendUser = user and user.RecommendedBook->includes(newRec) and result = true
            
        }

Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::recommendBook(uid:String,callNo:String,title:String,edition:String,author:String,publisher:String,description:String,isbn:String): Boolean {
          definition:
          user:User = User.allInstances()->any(u:User | u.UserID = uid), unusedCallNo:Boolean = if Book.allInstances()->select(b:Book | b.CallNo = callNo)->isEmpty() then true else false endif
            
            precondition:
          user.oclIsUndefined() = false and unusedCallNo = true
            
            postcondition:
          let newRec:RecommendBook in newRec.oclIsNew() and RecommendBook.allInstances()->includes(newRec) and newRec.CallNo = callNo and newRec.Title = title and newRec.Edition = edition and newRec.Author = author and newRec.Publisher = publisher and newRec.Description = description and newRec.ISBn = isbn and newRec.RecommendDate = Today and newRec.RecommendUser = user and user.RecommendedBook->includes(newRec) and result = true
            
        }

Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::renewBook(uid:String,barcode:String): Boolean {
          definition:
          user:User = User.allInstances()->any(u:User | u.UserID = uid), copy:BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(c:BookCopy | c.Barcode = barcode), loan:Loan = Loan.allInstances()->any(l:Loan | l.LoanedUser = user and l.LoanedCopy = copy and l.IsReturned = false), student:Student = Student.allInstances()->any(s:Student | s.UserID = uid), faculty:Faculty = Faculty.allInstances()->any(f:Faculty | f.UserID = uid), isStudent:Boolean = if student.oclIsUndefined() = false then true else false endif, isFaculty:Boolean = if faculty.oclIsUndefined() = false then true else false endif
            
            precondition:
          user.oclIsUndefined() = false and copy.oclIsUndefined() = false and loan.oclIsUndefined() = false and user.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::NORMAL and copy.IsReserved = false and loan.DueDate.isAfter(Today) and loan.OverDueFee = 0 and (if isStudent then student.LoanedBook->select(l:Loan | l.LoanedCopy = copy and l.IsReturned = false)->any(l:Loan | true).RenewedTimes < 3 else faculty.LoanedBook->select(l:Loan | l.LoanedCopy = copy and l.IsReturned = false)->any(l:Loan | true).RenewedTimes < 6 endif)
            
            postcondition:
          loan.RenewedTimes = loan.RenewedTimes@pre + 1 and loan.RenewDate = Today and (if isStudent then (if student.Programme = Programme::BACHELOR then loan.DueDate = loan.DueDate@pre.After(20) else (if student.Programme = Programme::MASTER then loan.DueDate = loan.DueDate@pre.After(40) else loan.DueDate = loan.DueDate@pre.After(60) endif) endif) else loan.DueDate = loan.DueDate@pre.After(60) endif) and result = true
            
        }
